head: 33d5d815b1d7cec9052157cb03ef2f7c9a7204dc
defensible_summary_supported: Substantial post-thesis methodological and engineering progress with new/extended governed evidence for RQ1, RQ2 and RQ4; direct paired perception (RQ3) and downstream model-transfer (RQ5) remain open. No stronger statement is made by the repo.

RQ1.thesis_baseline: byte-level nondeterministic; structurally/topologically stable under governed repeated runs; source not fully isolated
RQ1.current_status: AUTHORITATIVE (structural signature repeatability) + BOUNDED (timestamp-normalized byte equality; byte_nondeterminism_source='timestamp metadata suspected')
RQ1.did_it_isolate_the_source_more_precisely: YES, modestly: 3 repeated Osm2Odr runs differ only where timestamps appear (comment + header date), normalized hash collapses to one; identifies timestamp metadata as the observed source
RQ1.quantitatively_supported: partial - 3-run report.json (roads=32920, junctions=3717, len=1498527.59 identical; 3 distinct raw sha256). Gap: no tool/version binding recorded; claim correctly kept BOUNDED, not exhaustive

RQ2.thesis_baseline: whole-map comparison; delivered discrete-Frechet on uncropped/misaligned network; run_11 era baseline
RQ2.evaluation_method_improved: STRONGER_METHOD / REANALYSIS (local hull-footprint registration, curvature-sampling fix, local Frechet recompute closing thesis future-work #14)
RQ2.like_for_like_comparison: reports/post_audit_hardening/rq2_thesis_vs_current_comparison.json is status=NOT_RUN with thesis_value=null, current_value=null, comparisons=[], and an explicit claim_boundary: 'Current local evidence is not a thesis-vs-current controlled comparison and cannot prove improved map quality.' Required controls (CRS, footprint, registration, road_sampling, matching_threshold, metric_implementation) enumerated.
RQ2.footprint_change_flagged: 2.7-3.8x (convex-hull footprint) vs earlier 4.5-6x (bbox footprint) is a MEASUREMENT-SETTING change, correctly marked as not a map-quality improvement

RQ3.thesis_baseline: direct generated/manual paired perception NOT completed; Town10HD validated sensor-rig capability only
RQ3.post_thesis_classification: ENGINEERING_ENABLEMENT (blocker precisely characterized: CARLA RPC never becomes responsive, isolated via -nullrhi and independent of GPU driver) - NOT_NEW as a perceptual-gap answer
RQ3.verdict: CORRECT - infrastructure progress not presented as an answered perceptual question; Town10HD not relabeled as an RQ3 answer

RQ4.thesis_baseline: NT-Xent fixed representation collapse; latent separation with K=1000 permutation test p<0.001 (already statistically supported IN the thesis)
RQ4.post_thesis_classification: STRONGER_METHOD (5-seed union-domain robustness ensemble; resolves C18 one-sided-training OOD caveat) + REANALYSIS (numbers changed 2026-09-01 after fixing a graph-construction self-loop bug affecting ~99.8% of edges)
RQ4.quantitative_result: cosine_distance mean 0.6434, 95% bootstrap CI [0.616, 0.676]; cosine_similarity mean 0.357, CI [0.323, 0.384] excludes zero; seeds [42,43,44,45,46]
statistical_caveats: n=5 seeds is a small sample for a bootstrap CI (fragile tails); mitigated because all 5 raw similarity values are 0.30-0.39 (clearly non-zero) and the thesis K=1000 permutation p<0.001 remains the primary support

C21/aggregate_stats.json does not record tile counts or train/eval split; tile-overlap pseudo-replication cannot be fully excluded from this file alone (defensible for a diagnostic latent-separation claim, but should be documented)
RQ4.boundary_ok: YES - explicitly 'strengthens the thesis RQ4 result; does not make RQ4 wholly new post-thesis work'; comparability='extension'

RQ5.current_status: RQ5(a) DEFERRED_RUNTIME (needs RQ3 datasets), RQ5(b) DEFERRED_EXTERNAL_DATA (no real-world Ingolstadt dataset)
RQ5.verdict: CORRECT - unlabeled distribution shift / CORAL / MMD explicitly NOT relabeled as model-generalization accuracy; no frozen generated-trained checkpoint evaluated on manual holdout

statistics_red_flag_scan.train_test_leakage: not evidenced against; RQ4 tile split undocumented in evidence file (see RQ4 caveat)
statistics_red_flag_scan.tile_overlap_leakage: cannot fully exclude for RQ4 from aggregate_stats.json alone
statistics_red_flag_scan.inappropriate_seed_reuse: RQ4 seeds 42-46 distinct; no reuse detected
statistics_red_flag_scan.pseudo_replication: possible concern for RQ4 (5 seeds, in-sample latent distance) - bounded as diagnostic extension, not a generalization claim
statistics_red_flag_scan.sample_size_ambiguity: RQ4 sample_size=5 stated explicitly (seeds); RQ2 rows sample_size=null (scalar structural metrics, acceptable)
statistics_red_flag_scan.missing_confidence_intervals: RQ4 has bootstrap CI; RQ1/RQ2 are deterministic/structural (CIs not applicable)
statistics_red_flag_scan.multiple_comparison_issues: not applicable at current claim scope
statistics_red_flag_scan.cherry_picked_k: k_sweep is a listed RQ4 metric; not observed to be cherry-picked in committed evidence
statistics_red_flag_scan.map_footprint_change: FLAGGED and correctly handled as INCOMPARABLE (hull vs bbox) for RQ2
statistics_red_flag_scan.crs_alignment_change: required-control listed in rq2 comparison; comparison correctly NOT_RUN
